description: This file defines the CustomFieldModel class, a PHP class within the OrangeHRM project that models a custom field entity for the PIM module in the API layer. It uses traits for serialization and implements an interface to be normalizable, encapsulating metadata and constructor logic to set entity attributes and filters.

classes.name: CustomFieldModel
classes.description: A PHP model class representing a custom field in the PIM module API, providing serialization and normalization capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CustomFieldModel with a CustomField entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization purposes.
